prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Reordering sign-in after adoption, specific desktop flows (summon, visibility & control), targeted hints (photo upload, path helper, sign-in security), card carousel/single-click layouts, and control redesigns consistently won.
Harmful changes: Desktop docking setup flow, spotlight path selector layout, split personality redesign, account persistence hint, and specific copy changes (streamlined path copy, companion name certification copy) significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect: Loading/wait/progress indicators, notifications, tutorial/showcase screens, incentives, and several copy and layout variations showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large predicted gains (+8.5% to +15.0%) consistently overestimated actual impact, frequently resulting in minor gains, no clear effect, or early test cutoffs.
Predictions too low: Major winning tests—especially key desktop flows (visibility & control, summon flow), card carousel layout, and sign-in security hint—were significantly underestimated.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, reorder] Story First Flow Sequence Reorder: Reorder the entry experience so the story screen plays immediately before path selection to set clear emotional context. (why: Choose path drops 22.1% of users with a high mean time of 514s due to early hesitation before seeing the context.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Account Recovery Hint: Add an explicit hint on sign-in clarifying that users should log in with their previous social provider to recover existing pets. (why: 8 support emails (the single largest issue category) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again with a secondary provider.)
2: [finish, copy] Desktop Tray Shortcut Intro Copy: Update the finish screen headline and body copy to explicitly mention the system tray icon shortcut and right-click menu. (why: Users submitted multiple emails confused about how to hide or summon their pet after onboarding completes.)
